messages:
Maria CSM: Heads-up — planning QBR/EBR for Orion (renewal in ~6w). Need slides: health snapshot, usage trends, enablement plan, exec asks. Who can own each? :clipboard:

Devon CSM: I can take the health snapshot + renewal risk slide. Will pull renewal score and adoption metrics.

Priya OPS: I\u2019ll own usage trends and the 'what changed' charts. Need the metric queries — @Omar ENG can you drop the last 90d token/latency by workspace query?

Omar ENG: sending SQL in thread —

```sql
SELECT day, active_users, tokens_generated
FROM metrics.orion
WHERE day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days';
```

Will attach csv to the drive by EOD.

Len Product: I\u2019ll draft the enablement plan + workshop agenda. Can someone add customer contacts and preferred times? @Maria CSM

Maria CSM: putting contact list into the doc: Amelia Park (PM), Raj Patel (Eng), Suresh (Security). Preferred exec window: Tue 106nbsp;PT or Thu 26nbsp;PT. @Amy Exec can you confirm availability?

Amy Exec: Tue 10 PT works for me. I\u2019ll prep 3 executive asks: (1) contract flexibility for burst capacity, (2) timeline for private deployment pilot, (3) SLA uplift ask. I\u2019ll need a one-slide ask each.

Devon CSM: noted — I\u2019ll add renewal-risk slide with mitigation plan and recommended ask order.

Priya OPS: quick ask — do we want to show cost/per-token trend? Could be sensitive but helpful.

Maria CSM: yes, include cost trend but hide raw unit costs; show % change and savings from batching/quantization. Annotate assumptions.

Omar ENG: CSV uploaded: https://drive.google.com/orion-qbr-metrics. Also attaching thin screenshot of latency p95.

Len Product: added draft agenda + workshop exercises. pinged enablement team for run-through.

Calendar Bot: Calendar invite created for Tue 2026-04-08 10:00 PT — "Orion QBR / Renewal Review" — invite sent to: Maria CSM, Devon CSM, Priya OPS, Omar ENG, Len Product, Amy Exec.

Maria CSM: Action list recap:
- Devon CSM: health slide + renewal risk (due Mon 9AM PT)
- Priya OPS: usage trends + cost % charts (due Mon 12PM PT)
- Omar ENG: attach CSV + latency screenshots (done)
- Len Product: enablement plan + demo script (due Mon 5PM PT)
- Amy Exec: one-slide exec asks (due Mon 5PM PT)

Please react with :white_check_mark: when your slide is uploaded to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/orion-qbr-slides

Devon CSM: :white_check_mark: will upload by 8AM.

Priya OPS: :white_check_mark: targeting 11:30AM.

Len Product: :white_check_mark: will upload draft and a 10-min demo clip.

Amy Exec: :white_check_mark: slides done; will iterate after run-through.

Maria CSM: Thanks everyone. We'll do a 30m internal dry-run Mon 4PM PT — calendar invite incoming. If anything blocks, flag here.

Suresh (Customer): Quick security note — for private pilot ask, need data flow diagram + compliance checklist. @Omar ENG / @Len Product can you confirm?

Omar ENG: I\u2019ll drop the initial dataflow diagram in the doc. Expect a security checklist ready Tue morning.

Len Product: I\u2019ll include compliance contact and proposed pilot timeline (46ndash;6 weeks) in slide notes.

Maria CSM: perfect. Closing thread 12 will post final slide master after dry-run.
